summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — wholly distinct from Laomedon king of Troy, father of Priam, whom Heracles slew when the king defrauded the gods and the hero alike.
Not to be confused with `laomedes-zacynthus`, the earlier name in the same Epitome list, nor with the Trojan royal `laomedon`.

story.text: Apollodorus names Laomedon among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Daesenor and before Laodicus in Epitome 7.29.
